shared_elements: overlapping pair of figures side by side
wing or fleece rendered as regular rows of overlapping feather/scale-like units
dense incised linear patterning covering the body
curled/hooked details rendered by concentric incised lines
justification: Both surfaces show paired, overlapping profile figures whose bodies/wings are covered in the same convention of regular rows of overlapping feather- or scale-like units drawn with fine incised lines, a fairly specific shared carving idiom. The decisive difference is the subject: A depicts two horned animal heads with prominent spiralled horns and fleece, while B depicts anthropomorphic winged figures with arms and hands, so the actual creatures and their attributes do not match.
